grader.scenario: Mobile data roaming unexpectedly blocked in Europe before major business pitch; 2 customer outbursts (one handled, one unhandled); 6+ faults (poor)
grader.notes: Poor call featuring dead air breaches, two customer outbursts (first handled, second unhandled), rude remarks, failed verification and personalization, and active listening repeat.
